reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended The bare Haiku 4.5 model ID is unsupported for on-demand Bedrock inference, preventing benchmark responses unless a supported inference-profile ID is used.
1 open issue - [Use a supported Haiku 4.5 inference profile ID](https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/pull/1924#discussion_r4517217874) · New
What changed in this PR Updates Claude model references across Pixeltable’s documentation, sample apps, and benchmark tooling without changing library runtime code. **Changes:** - Replaces retired Claude 3.x IDs in examples and provider defaults. - Adds the required `max_tokens` argument to the Anthropic docstring example. - Moves sample apps to Sonnet 4.6 and removes sampling overrides from the trading app. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tool/​perftest_providers.py` | Updates Anthropic, Bedrock, and OpenRouter benchmark defaults. | | `pixeltable/​functions/​openrouter.py` | Refreshes model IDs in parameter documentation and examples. | | `pixeltable/​functions/​anthropic.py` | Updates the example model and supplies `max_tokens`. | | `docs/​sample-apps/​reddit-agentic-bot/​config.py` | Sets the default model to Sonnet 4.6. | | `docs/​sample-apps/​ai-based-trading-insight-chrome-extension/​server/​schema.py` | Removes sampling overrides while preserving the system prompt. | | `docs/​sample-apps/​ai-based-trading-insight-chrome-extension/​server/​config.py` | Sets the default model to Sonnet 4.6. | | `docs/​_guidelines/​GUIDELINES_FOR_COOKBOOKS.md` | Updates the cookbook example to Haiku 4.5. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: Haiku 4.5 requires a geographic or global inference-profile ID on the Bedrock runtime endpoint; this bare foundation-model ID does not support on-demand inference ([AWS model card](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-haiku-4-5.html)). `bedrock.converse()` forwards the ID unchanged, so this replacement cannot produce benchmark responses. Use a supported profile ID, such as `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0`, selected for the configured AWS region and data-residency requirements.
